analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Marketing
analysis.quote: Your Personal Data may be disclosed to third parties (such as Cisco business partners or vendors) so that they may inform you about websites, programs, products, or services that may be of interest to you.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Communication Content
analysis.quote: It may include: Communications content (such as audio, video, text), social media and discussion forum, or other communications details when you interact with Cisco

analysis.headline: Public Forum Data Uncontrolled
analysis.quote: If you participate in a discussion forum, local communities, or chat room on a Cisco website, you should be aware that the information you provide there (such as your public profile and comments) will be made broadly available to others and could be used to contact you, to send you unsolicited messages, or for purposes neither Cisco nor you have control over.

analysis.headline: Automated Decisions Impact You
analysis.quote: Where an individual's rights and legitimate interests may be impacted by such automated decision-making, we will provide the impacted individual the opportunity to inquire about the decision or request manual review.

analysis.headline: Acquires Your Data From Others
analysis.quote: We also acquire Personal Data from trusted third-party sources and engage third parties to collect Personal Data on our behalf, in accordance with applicable laws.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Internationally
analysis.quote: As Cisco is a global organization, Personal Data may be transferred to Cisco in the United States of America, to any Cisco subsidiary worldwide, or to third parties and business partners as described above that are located in various jurisdictions around the world.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: Our third-party partners may use cookies or similar technologies to provide you with advertising based on your browsing activities and interests.

analysis.headline: Opt-Out Per-Site, Per-Device
analysis.quote: Please note that specific Cisco web properties may store or process data in different ways; therefore, you may need to repeat this process again for various reasons, including but not limited to: If you have taken the action on one Cisco-owned domain (e.g., cisco.com ) you may need to take action separately on another Cisco-owned domain.
